{{Quote|The Empire ruined my life and destroyed my family&mdash;I wouldn't mind getting a chance to strike back.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />}}
A '''family''' included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kyp Durron]], his brother [[Zeth Durron]], and their [[Kyp Durron's mother|mother]] and [[Kyp Durron's father|father]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="1 BBY">According to ''[[Jedi Search]]'' [[Kyp Durron]] was eight when he and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Since he is eighteen in [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], which was set in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the family must have been arrested in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> the family was arrested by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the parents anti-Imperial protests. The parents and Kyp were sent to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice mines of Kessel]], where Kyp's mother and father were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a prison revolt<ref name="NEGTC" /> in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Death date">According to ''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'', [[Kyp Durron]]'s [[Parent/Legends|Parents]] [[Death/Legends|died]] one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after they were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. ''[[Jedi Search]]'' states that Durron was eight when the family was first sent to Kessel. Since he is eighteen in [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], which is set in [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the year of Kyp's mother's death can be calculated as [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> Zeth was taken to the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] at [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] and indoctrinated into Imperial ideology. Kyp survived for years on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] until he was eventually taken offworld by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. He sought revenge on the Empire for the death of his family, and while under the influence of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], gained control of the [[Sun Crusher]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], which he took to the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]]. After Imperials at the Academy told Kyp that Zeth was dead, Kyp fired a [[resonance torpedo]] into [[Caridan (star)|Carida's sun]] to [[Destruction of Carida|destroy]] the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Only afterward, the Imperials revealed that Zeth was still alived, but he perished in the resulting disaster. Kyp was later freed from Kun's influence and joined the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="NEGTC" />
